equipment.name: Demon Hunter
equipment.effect: Tank killer: deals bonus damage based on the target's max HP.
equipment.notes: MTE comp guides call it 'Demon Hunter Sword'; the equipment guide names it 'Demon Hunter'. Naming discrepancy flagged.

equipment.name: Rose Gold Meteor
equipment.effect: Grants bonus attack and a shield when the carrier drops to low HP.

equipment.name: Blade of Despair
equipment.effect: Executes low-HP enemies: deals massive bonus damage to / finishes off weakened targets.

equipment.name: Golden Staff
equipment.effect: Continuously increases the carrier's attack speed (stacking attack-speed effect).

equipment.name: Sea Halberd
equipment.effect: Counters lifesteal (applies healing reduction) and provides high penetration.

equipment.name: War Axe
equipment.effect: Grants spell vamp (heals from skill damage dealt).

equipment.effect: Restores mana at the start of battle.

equipment.name: Winter Crown
equipment.effect: Makes the carrier invincible at low HP (brief stasis/freeze).

equipment.name: Ice Queen Wand
equipment.effect: Grants spell vamp (heals from magic skill damage dealt).

equipment.name: Blood Wings
equipment.effect: Periodically grants the carrier a shield.

equipment.name: Blade Armor
equipment.effect: Reflects physical damage back at attackers.

equipment.name: Immortality
equipment.effect: Resurrects the carrier on death with a portion of HP.

equipment.name: Dominance Ice
equipment.effect: Grants more mana regeneration when the carrier takes damage.

equipment.name: Brute Force Breastplate
equipment.effect: Grants attack speed and crowd-control reduction.

equipment.name: Mirror Device
equipment.effect: Clones the equipped hero (also created by Aamon's Blade of Resonance).

equipment.name: Claude's Theft
equipment.effect: Grants two random equipment at the beginning of the game.

equipment.effect: Enhanceable Heavenly Artifact; used by Commander Zilong.

equipment.effect: Grants control immunity at the start of battle.

equipment.name: Flicker
equipment.effect: Blinks at the start of battle and grants attack speed.

equipment.name: Retribution
equipment.effect: Kills level up the carrier and increase its damage.

equipment.name: Sun Staff
equipment.effect: Skills trigger an extra magic explosion.
